name: Midrange all-flash, RAID 5 (8+1)
description: Synthetic vendor-neutral midrange all-flash array with RAID 5 (8 data + 1 parity). Educational demonstration profile; not a real array.
assumptions: write-back cache with no write coalescing; every logical write destages as one modeled backend block
no rebuild or degraded-state activity is modeled
single declared read-cache hit fraction of 0.30 is a simplification applied to all logical reads
spares and metadata reserves are excluded from usable capacity
equal declared limits across protection-layout variants are a comparison device, not identical hardware

baselineLatency.basis: synthetic weekly values declared for M1; M2 derives them from the trace
